builds.name: base
builds.note: the reel before the session: SwiftUI ScrollView, snapping and position tracking off the per-frame path (3a6b5b7's views, c79350e's bench)

builds.name: v1
builds.note: H1: per-column focused/onScreen flags, so a tab click invalidates one column instead of every Column body

builds.name: v2
builds.note: H2: a non-movable window with a custom drag area, to remove a per-frame focus walk seen in a stale trace; reverted

builds.name: v3
builds.note: H3: the first AppKit reel (NSScrollView of hosting views); Auto Layout's sizeThatFits on 16 hosting views is the new wall

builds.name: v4
builds.note: H4: the representable answers sizeThatFits itself, so Auto Layout never sizes the hosting views

builds.name: v5
builds.note: H5/H6: slides as additive Core Animation in the render server (e6d3625) and heads-first open (9bcd41a)

steps.hypothesis: per-column focused/onScreen flags: a step invalidates only the columns whose flags changed
steps.why: ab-flags-step: every metric inside the noise band; the session kept it for its body counts, the loop drops it

steps.hypothesis: a non-movable window removes the per-frame focus walk
steps.why: the walk was already gone in the champion: no gain, and the replay shows the screen saying so in 40 s

steps.hypothesis: an AppKit NSScrollView reel takes SwiftUI's scroll machinery off the per-frame path
steps.why: the find to make: the screen's worst-stretch stacks name LayoutEngineBox.sizeThatFits → PlatformViewLayoutEngine.sizeThatFits, without xctrace

steps.expect: lateFrames up, not a regression; explain reports the rate change
steps.why: wrong turn 2 (H5): 8 → 30 late frames read as +275 % because the panel went from 24 to 48 Hz; the hitch ratio and CPU ms decide

steps.hypothesis: the representable answers sizeThatFits itself, so Auto Layout never sizes the 16 hosting views

steps.why: wrong turn 1 (H2): a trace recorded on base-dir must not drive an experiment on a later champion (v3 or v4); refused unless --allow-stale

steps.expect: NSScrollAnimationHelper / ViewGraph.invalidateTransform is the largest remaining attributable subtree
steps.why: the render-server slide find: what v5 removed

steps.hypothesis: slides as additive Core Animation in the render server, and a project opens heads-first
heads-first open: a switch shows the new columns' heads before their threads
steps.why: the second scenario: the same build must not be worse on switch (it was 544 → 153 ms by hand)

notes: v1–v4 were built from uncommitted working trees on c79350e; their mapping to hypotheses comes from the ab-*.txt names and the essay, and the agent that built them should confirm it (SPEC §6.1)
the builds predate the stamp: they enter the store with perfloop store import, and promotions of dirty imports pass --allow-dirty (a replay, not a release)
via run: one child per side reads CPU ms per step from each rep's mainThread.cpuMs, which the session's binaries already record; their ab predates the objective
